units: Gen. R. s. 41 none among the nations are קשה מא׳ more obstinate than the Em.—Trnsf. Emorean, superstitious, heathen-like. דרכי הא׳ superstitious practices.

<cite ref="Shabbat 67a">Sabb. 67ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>אין בו משום דרכי הא׳</he> is not to be looked upon (not forbidden) as an imitation of &c.; <he>יש בו משום דרכי הא׳</he> it is forbidden because it has the appearance of superstitious practices.
